name: Sobetsu (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Sobetsu town emblem in white: a ring beneath a stylised crown-like device.
history: Municipal flag of Sobetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 30 June 1958.

features.role: Sobetsu town emblem — a ring beneath a stylised crown-like device
